documents.description: Public copy: no phone, extra detail.

_notes.documents: Each document is a separate content cut of the same resume.json. Tag content with "include_in": ["<document id>"] to restrict it to one.
_notes.variants: Each variant is a role-targeted cut. Tag content with "variants": ["<variant id>"]. 'label' is appended to the filename; use "" for no suffix.
_notes.title_overrides: Maps an experience item 'id' to a replacement job title, for this variant only. Never do a global find/replace on titles.
